Hi! I’m Andres, based in Argentina, working as Sales Manager for WeTravel. We’re currently hiring a motivated and proactive Account Executive to drive our growth in LATAM. In this role, you’ll focus on bringing small-to-medium-sized, multi-day tour operators onto our platform—helping them streamline their operations and scale their businesses.

Our goal is bold: we’re building the world’s leading booking and payments platform for group travel / multi-day tour operators. You’ll be instrumental in expanding our footprint across the region and contributing directly to that mission.

How We Work

At WeTravel, our Sales team runs lean, fast, and collaboratively. You’ll manage the entire sales cycle—from cold outreach to closing the deal—with a strong focus on volume-based activity. What sets this role apart is the high degree of autonomy and accountability: you\'ll be expected to spend the majority of your time prospecting, demoing, and following up with qualified leads.

We embrace a consultative sales approach, using tools like HubSpot to manage pipelines and stay organized. If you’re someone who loves helping business owners and thrives in a high-energy, remote-friendly environment, this is the place for you.

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

You Should Apply If You

  • Are fluent in English and Spanish (and any other languages? Highlight them in your resume!).
  • Are comfortable with high-volume outbound sales, especially phone-based outreach.
  • Have excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Are passionate about helping SME travel companies grow.
  • Have experience managing or contributing to full sales cycles.
  • Have inside sales experience via emails and calls.
  • Have worked in B2B tech sales, especially targeting SMBs.
  • Have knowledge of HubSpot CRM or similar platforms.
  • Understand the travel industry in LATAM or have a relevant network.

You Might Not Be The Right Fit If You

  • Dislike making cold calls or engaging in proactive outreach.
  • Are unfamiliar with consultative selling or full-cycle sales processes.
  • Struggle with remote work autonomy or time management.
  • Prefer a highly structured or reactive sales environment.

On a Weekly Basis You Will Find Yourself

  • Prospecting and calling multi-day tour operators based in LATAM region.
  • Running consultative demos tailored to the unique needs of travel businesses.
  • Managing your pipeline and follow-ups using HubSpot CRM.
  • Closing deals and supporting onboarding to ensure client success.
  • Meeting or exceeding weekly KPIs for outreach, demos, and new bookings.
  • Providing market feedback to the wider team to refine product and messaging.

Benefits

  • Attractive compensation - uncapped commission. Base Fulltime Salary is $20,000 (USD) (On Target Earnings: Year 1 OTE = $50,000, Year 2 OTE: $80,000).
  • Fulltime - Fixed Term Contract (as International Contractor).
  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.
  • Amsterdam Program – visit us in Amsterdam (HQ) for 2-4 weeks every year, staying in one of our WeTravel apartments.
  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.
  • Annual team off-site (often somewhere sunny).
  • Extensive paid family leave.
  • Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.
  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.
  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success. Coverage for certain work-from-home (WFH) equipment.
  • Cambly for colleagues for whom English is not their first language.
  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

Please Note

  • As a member of our international team, you’ll work full-time under a B2B contractor agreement, with monthly payments in USD.
  • For this role, we can only consider candidates who have the full legal right to work in LATAM region. Unfortunately, WeTravel is not able to offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you\'re excited about this opportunity and believe you\'re a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at TigerData (creators of TimescaleDB) .

At TigerData, formerly Timescale, we empower developers and businesses with the fastest PostgreSQL platform designed for transactional, analytical, and agentic workloads. Trusted globally by thousands of organizations, TigerData accelerates real-time insights, drives intelligent applications, and powers critical infrastructure at scale. As a globally distributed, remote-first team committed to direct communication, accountability, and collaborative excellence, we are shaping the future of data infrastructure, built for speed, flexibility, and simplicity.

TigerData is looking for a skilled and innovative Data Engineer with expertise in building scalable data infrastructure and a passion for enabling data-driven decision making across the organization. You will play a crucial role in designing, building, and maintaining the data systems that power our analytics, product insights, and business intelligence initiatives for Timescale, our open-source database for real-time analytics and time series at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from various sources including application databases, event streams, and third-party APIs.
  • Architect and optimize data warehouse solutions, ensuring efficient storage, retrieval, and processing of large-scale time-series and analytical datasets.
  • Implement and maintain data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, and alerting mechanisms to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and reliability across all data systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Marketing, Finance, and Sales to understand data requirements and build infrastructure that enables self-service analytics and advanced data exploration.
  • Optimize database performance, including query optimization, indexing strategies, and capacity planning for both operational and analytical workloads.
  • Build and maintain data infrastructure using cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern data stack tools, ensuring scalability, security, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Develop and maintain data documentation, schemas, and governance processes to ensure data discoverability and proper usage across teams.
  • Work closely with Engineering teams to implement event tracking, logging, and instrumentation that captures meaningful product and user behavior data.
  • Support real-time data processing requirements and streaming analytics use cases, leveraging Timescale\'s time-series capabilities.
  • Champion data engineering best practices, including version control, testing, monitoring, and CI/CD for data pipelines.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of proven experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or similar role, with significant experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Expert proficiency in SQL for complex data transformations, performance optimization, and working with large datasets. Strong PostgreSQL experience is highly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Python or another programming language for data pipeline development, automation, and scripting.
  • Experience with modern data stack tools such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar orchestration and transformation frameworks.
  • Strong experience with cloud data platforms (AWS Redshift/RDS, Google BigQuery/Cloud SQL, Azure Synapse, or Snowflake) and their associated data services.
  • Understanding of data modeling concepts, dimensional modeling, and database design principles for both OLTP and OLAP systems.
  • Experience with data visualization and BI tools (Metabase, Tableau, Looker) and building data marts for analytical consumption.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, and privacy principles, including experience with data lineage and cataloging tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot complex data issues, optimize performance bottlenecks, and scale systems efficiently.
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with strong communication skills for collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices including version control, testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with time-series databases, developer tooling, or data infrastructure products is a significant advantage.
  • Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Our Commitment

  • We respond to every applicant.
  • We review applications fairly and objectively, and shortlist based on relevant skills and experience.
  • We ensure clear and timely communication throughout your candidate journey.
  • We maintain a rigorous interview process with a high bar, designed to give you the opportunity to meet various team members you\'ll collaborate with across our organization.

About TigerData

TigerData, formerly Timescale, sets the standard as the fastest PostgreSQL platform for modern workloads. Trusted by more than 2,000 customers across 25+ countries and powering over 3 million active databases, we enable developers and organizations to build real-time, intelligent applications at scale. Backed by $180 million from top-tier investors, TigerData is building the new standard for data infrastructure, built on PostgreSQL, designed for the future.

Want to get a feel for how we work and what we value? Check out our blog post: What It Takes to Thrive at TigerData .

We embrace diversity, curiosity, and collaboration. Whether debating the perfect chicken nugget crunch, sharing workout routines, or discussing your favorite plants and pets, you\'ll find your community here.

Our Tech Stack

We don\'t require previous experience with our tech stack, but enthusiasm for learning is key. Our technologies include PostgreSQL, Tiger Cloud, AWS, Go, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, and innovative features like Hypertables, Hypercore, vector search, and real-time analytics.

Learn more at or follow us on Twitter @TigerDatabase

What We Offer

(Please note that benefits may vary based on country.)

  • Flexible PTO and comprehensive family leave
  • Fridays off in August
  • Fully remote opportunities globally
  • Stock options for long-term growth
  • Monthly WiFi stipend
  • Professional development and educational resources
  • Premium insurance options for you and your family (US-based employees)

Ready to join the future of PostgreSQL? We can\'t wait to meet you.

Após conquistar o Brasil com um modelo de negócios pioneiro no mercado de Aluguel e Compra e Vendas de imóveis, expandimos para o mercado internacional ao adquirirmos o Grupo Navent, Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) e Equador (Plusvalia) - entre outros.

Oferecemos um ecossistema de ponta a ponta para facilitar a vida daqueles que procuram alugar ou comprar uma casa, vender um imóvel e desbloquear uma transação. Pense em zero papel ou burocracia: tudo acontece em uma única plataforma, com transparência e rapidez ao lado de um suporte humanizado e próximo.

Atualmente, estamos avaliados em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões (agosto de 2021) e continuamos a crescer 4x ano após ano, quebrando recordes.

Para que tudo isso aconteça, contamos com mais de 4 mil pessoas talentosas, trabalhando com tecnologia de ponta e as melhores práticas de design para garantir uma experiência perfeita durante todo o processo de venda e locação, aliada também a produtos financeiros inteligentes. Aqui você vai trabalhar com os melhores profissionais do mercado, num ambiente que respira inovação, colaboração e alta performance.

Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo.

title: [BM] SR Data Architect – Google Cloud Focus
description:
Join to apply for the (BM) SR Data Architect – Google Cloud Focus role at Zallpy Digital .

We are a technology company focused on digital transformation, with a collaborative and inclusive culture. This 100% remote position offers opportunities to work across modern cloud-native data architectures and API-led integrations.

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, and manage end-to-end data architecture: data models, storage solutions, data flows, and processing pipelines — prioritizing GCP-native services.
  • Lead GCP-native ingestion from Salesforce and NetSuite into BigQuery using BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Dataflow, Data Fusion, and orchestration with Cloud Composer.
  • Implement Salesforce pipelines with Bulk API (high-volume loads) and REST API (incremental sync), applying rate-limit handling (batch sizing, retries, exponential backoff).
  • Design NetSuite → BigQuery connectors with secure OAuth 2.0 or Token-Based authentication, incremental loading (lastModifiedDate, Saved Searches, SuiteQL), and schema evolution strategies.
  • Define Dataplex governance using Terraform — including metadata ingestion, policy tags, lineage tracking, RBAC, and Data Quality rules as CI/CD gates.
  • Apply a Terraform-first approach for provisioning all repeatable resources (BigQuery, Dataplex, IAM, policy tags, Apigee components), ensuring consistency and version control.
  • Integrate AWS data sources (e.g., Redshift) into GCP and support the deprecation of legacy tools (e.g., MuleSoft) in favor of API-led architectures via Apigee.
  • Continuously evaluate architecture for scalability, performance, cost-efficiency, and security.
  • Standardize and maintain documentation of architecture patterns, processes, and runbooks.
  • Partner with Data Engineers, Analysts, and Data Stewards to translate business requirements into robust data solutions.
  • Lead architecture reviews, best-practice sessions, and mentor peers to enhance team capabilities.

What We Are Looking For

  • Advanced/Fluent English for technical discussions and stakeholder communication.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Significant experience in data architecture with a strong GCP focus.
  • Hands-on expertise in BigQuery, Dataflow, Data Fusion, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, and Cloud Storage.
  • Proven experience with Salesforce (Bulk/REST API) and NetSuite pipelines (OAuth 2.0 / Token-Based, incremental loads, schema evolution).
  • Experience with Apigee Integration for API-led connectivity and secure API exposure.
  • Strong background in security and compliance for regulated data environments.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, warehousing, governance, lineage, and quality practices.
  • Cross-cloud experience (GCP and AWS).
  • Ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures and enforce technical standards.

It Will Be a Plus If You Have

  • Experience migrating from MuleSoft or similar legacy platforms to cloud-native/API-led solutions.

Where You Will Work

  • This is a 100% remote position.

  • PJ.

Experiences and Development: Opportunities to participate in trips, workshops, events, and team-building activities.

Whether in your personal or professional life, Zallpy cares about your growth and well-being! Join us on this journey!

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We’re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. Darkroom has been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager, you’ll bring sharp strategy, organizational excellence, and creative instinct to every project. This role blends content strategy, project management, copywriting, and digital performance analysis - perfect for someone who thrives on moving seamlessly between planning and execution. You’ll be the glue connecting design, video, and messaging, turning ideas into structured campaigns that perform across IG, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and email.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST time zone, open to candidates in Portugal and Brazil.

What You’ll Do

  • Strategy, Planning & Execution: Own the content calendar; plan, manage, and execute the content pipeline across IG, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and email using Notion.
  • Coordinate across teams: Work with the Design Lead and Video Lead to align on timelines, asset creation, and creative strategy.
  • Deploy consistently: Schedule and publish all organic social posts and newsletters; ensure content is on-message and on time.
  • Stay agile: Adapt to shifting priorities and post needs without dropping quality or speed.
  • Coordinate the email pipeline: Plan email newsletters.
  • Drive Darkroom’s email strategy: Support strategic initiatives for Darkroom’s email marketing campaigns in partnership with the Design Lead and Video Lead.

Social Media Management

  • Hands-on ownership of Darkroom’s organic presence on Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
  • Write copy: Post captions, headlines and descriptions that match platform-specific tone and brand voice.
  • Community engagement: Monitor and respond to comments and DMs. Actively engage with customers, creators, and collaborators.

Paid Media

  • Understand paid social and ad copywriting and collaborate with the paid media specialist on Darkroom’s paid ads.

SEO, Reporting, Analytics & Performance

  • Work with our SEO specialist to track performance across all owned platforms and campaigns (social, email, website).
  • SEO + UX insights: Use Microsoft Clarity and Google Analytics to identify friction points and opportunities for optimization.
  • Report intelligently: Provide actionable insights, trends, and growth metrics that influence creative direction.

You’re a Great Fit If You

  • Have 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on content, email, and social.
  • Are highly organized, autonomous, and thrive in fast-paced, iterative environments.
  • Write with precision and tone, and know how to adapt voice across channels.
  • Know what content performs, and why.
  • Have strong project management instincts and can juggle timelines, tasks and tools.
  • Understand digital performance: you’ve worked with analytics tools, know your way around email metrics and think SEO.
  • Communicate clearly and can collaborate with designers and video editors.

Bonus Points If You

  • Have experience working inside an agency.
  • Have managed newsletter content and owned media channels.
  • Are fluent in Notion, Figma, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, GT Metrix.
  • Have worked on brand-led social content.

What It’s Like To Work At Darkroom

We’re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Equity incentives and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this transition, ensuring time to bond with families while maintaining work-life balance.

title: Clinical Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Clinical Manager role at IQVIA .

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. The Patient Centered Solutions (PCS) team leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions. We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to design scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative (e.g. interviews, focus groups), quantitative (e.g. clinical outcome assessments (COAs)/patient-reported outcomes (PROS), preference research) and passive (e.g. digital health technology tools) approaches to understand patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment.

To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time the IQVIA PCS team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have both consulting skills and life science skills that can be applied to PCS research activities . Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity to address challenging client issues, across multiple geographies with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering solutions . We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth.

Role & Responsibilities

The role-holder will need to be a committed individual, who combines high emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills. They will thrive in a fast-paced environment and be comfortable managing conflicting priorities. The environment is dynamic and ever-changing, moving at the pace of our clients’ needs and the candidate will be expected to understand the sense of urgency that is synonymous with the business.

As a Consultant, ClinRO Services within the PCS team at IQVIA, you will directly administer assessments to participants in a clinical trial, or evaluate the quality of assessments performed by others and provide feedback regarding interview technique and scoring . Responsibilities include:

  • Review of scales administered by raters in a clinical trial to ensure that assessments are being conducted in a standardized manner to ensure data reliability.
  • Evaluate the quality of assessments, conducting live interactions with raters to discuss assessment methodology, scoring technique, and to provide guidance, as necessary.
  • Evaluate case data and appropriately prepare for discussions with raters (e.g., prepared to discuss relevant issues and scale items, and have necessary documents available).
  • Complete rater interactions and assigned tasks as scheduled.
  • Responsible for timely submission of all documentation associated with assigned tasks.
  • Participate in all orientation, training and calibration activities as required.
  • Functional assessments of rater performance (e.g., mock interview) and assistance in preparing and disseminating communications.
  • Contacting clinical trial participants remotely (e.g., via proprietary app, Engage) to administer assessments, and will appropriately document resultant information (e.g., notes, scores).

What do you need to apply?

  • Minimum of a Master’s degree (MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric, Nursing or Social Work, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years clinical experience working with central nervous system (CNS) trials preferred. Experience working with related psychiatric populations & experience administering psychiatric assessments, ratings scales and/or structured clinical interviews is a plus.
  • Ideally this person should have previous experience in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, depression, schizophrenia, anxiety.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to interact with all levels of personnel and clientele in a professional manner.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, time management and problem solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications (solid excel/power point knowledge).

Home based position in Latin America.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an IoT Solutions Architecture Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you.

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

The role entails

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Overview

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. You will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

Responsibilities

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs/roadmap; break initiatives into epics/stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope/out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs/screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready/Done and maintain Confluence specs/decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views/boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs/specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation/engagement/retention, run A/B experiments, and prioritize UX/performance/stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features/flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer: what was completed today; the current task and ETA for completion; the next 3 tasks with planned start/end dates; tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer); tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards/filters with Stage/Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code/PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC/AV concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate an inclusive culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
About The Role
As a Regional Alliances Manager (RAM) in the South of Latin America (SOLA) , you will be responsible for driving new business opportunities with and through a partner list in the SOLA territory (Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, Perú, and Uruguay). Success in this position will require working with internal teams and leading our strategic Partners (like NeoSecure, KC-Latam, Nastec, Orion, Urudata, AWS, Google, among others), to deliver growth with CrowdStrike. A successful candidate will possess excellent energy, to be capable of building a strong, productive relationship with your partners, focusing on growing our business opportunities, and achievement of a marked increase in the number of partner-originated opportunities/deal registrations. Candidates with current strong cybersecurity knowledge are encouraged to apply.
This role is available to candidates located in Santiago de Chile or Buenos Aires.
What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with partners within the countries regarding successful engagement, launches, and enablement up to and including the delivery of sales, product, and support training as required.
  • Coordinate with Alliances Solutions Architects on technical enablement for partners. Develop a technical enablement strategy that supports the channel sales growth strategy for the territory.
  • Support/facilitate engagement of our internal sales and technical teams with partners’ sales and technical teams.
  • Strategize/coordinate with field marketing on the design and execution of marketing programs/events/campaigns to create interest and awareness among partners’ customers.
  • Develop a business plan outlining how target revenues and objectives for the year will be achieved, including quarterly business reviews.
  • Proactively maintain ongoing knowledge of industry, territory, existing and target channel partner accounts, & competitive landscape.
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of CrowdStrike products, sales strategies/objectives, value proposition, and competition.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.
What You’ll Need
  • University/College degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of channel sales experience in a software/SaaS business-to-business environment with a proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strategic thinker and hunter mentality who takes initiative and is capable of hands-on problem solving as well as the ability to generate ideas and solutions.
  • Partner development experience as well as experience with decision makers within current relationships within the Channel.
  • Ability to communicate with partners at all levels - from sales rep to C-level and business owner.
  • Motivated and focused self-starter with strong leadership skills who can multi-task and work independently or within a team.
  • Strong organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English
  • Candidate must be based in Santiago de Chile or Buenos Aires.
Bonus Points
  • Previous sales experience in the information security space and strong technical knowledge with a broad range of security and networking technologies.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

As a key member of our International Sales team, you will drive ORBCOMM’s growth and market presence in Brazil by identifying new opportunities, cultivating strategic partnerships, and implementing innovative solutions to expand our customer base. This role focuses on business expansion through both direct sales and indirect channels, contributing to the overall growth of ORBCOMM’s product lines in the region.

You will be collaborating with a talented global and local team, while also enjoying the autonomy and comfort of remote work.

  • Develop and execute strategic business plans to identify and capitalize on new sales opportunities in Brazil.

  • Identify, approach, and convert leads into customers, managing the entire sales cycle, including negotiations and contract management.
  • Represent ORBCOMM at industry events, trade shows, and other forums to promote the brand and its solutions in the LATAM market.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the telematics product portfolio and ensure certification processes align with market needs.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive positioning, providing actionable insights to leadership.
  • Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline, focusing on upselling, cross-selling, and long-term business development.
  • Organize and deliver corporate presentations, proposals, and training sessions for customers and partners.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to design and implement campaigns that strengthen ORBCOMM’s brand awareness.
  • Ensure all activities align with ORBCOMM’s overarching business development goals and strategic priorities.
  • Travel Requirements: Be prepared for frequent travel (estimated at up to 70%) to customer sites, industry events, and ORBCOMM offices as needed to support.

Who You Are:

You’re a strategic thinker with a knack for operational excellence, ready to tackle multiple priorities with agility and grace. If you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in new business development, sales, or account management within telecommunications, IoT, or related technology sectors.
  • Proven track record as a hunter, consistently identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new opportunities in competitive markets.
  • Deep understanding of transportation and logistics markets, including cold-chain logistics, ERP, and transport management solutions.
  • Strategic thinker with proven success applying structured sales methodologies like MEDDPIC and Challenger to drive predictable revenue growth and close complex deals.
  • Skilled in identifying champions, navigating complex buying groups, and aligning solutions with customer decision criteria using CRM and sales enablement platforms.
  • Strong communicator with excellent analytical and interpersonal skills, comfortable working in multicultural, cross-functional environments.
  • Highly self-motivated and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced setting.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish or other additional languages are a strong asset.
  • Willing and able to travel up to 70% of the time.

Then we want to meet you!

About Us:

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology, that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change by visiting us at !

Ready to Join Us?

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:
Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences. É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição do emprego

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem, extração e homogeneização, por exemplo;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores e acompanhar auxiliares e estagiários em procedimentos quando solicitado pelo Coordenador do Setor
  • Incluir os resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema (de acordo com a respectiva linha de negócio), bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Participar de forma supervisionada nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login/Triagem) quanto às amostras em processamento, seguida de impressão de mapa de trabalho. Armazenar essas amostras de forma organizada no setor.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;
  • Realizar as tarefas gerais do laboratório de acordo com a divisão de tarefas definidas pelo Coordenador que pode incluir: preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Comunicar a necessidade de materiais e necessidade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, e quando necessário realizar as manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos seguindo as recomendações do fabricante e as orientações do Analista Sênior ou Coordenador
  • Manter os freezers, geladeiras, armários, gavetas, prateleiras e bancadas organizados, mantendo cada insumo armazenado em temperatura preconizada pelo fabricante (ambiente, refrigerado ou congelado);
  • Limpar e desinfetar a área de trabalho (bancada) antes e depois da rotina, seguindo o procedimento específico;
  • Vistoriar mensalmente os insumos quanto à data de vencimento; informar o Coordenador do Setor com antecedência sobre o vencimento e realizar o descarte quando necessário;
  • Utilizar todos os EPIs necessários para a realização das tarefas com segurança e de acordo com as normas de segurança dos laboratórios;
  • Arquivar documentos de acordo com treinamento da qualidade;

O Operador de Telemarketing tem como principal função realizar atendimentos ativos e receptivos. Isso significa que o profissional pode tanto entrar em contato com clientes quanto receber ligações. As tarefas incluem fornecer informações, sanar dúvidas, registrar solicitações e, em alguns casos, oferecer produtos e serviços.

Ensino médio completo

Ser maior de 18 anos

Possuir computador com acesso à internet

Residir em Nossa Senhora do Socorro , Barra dos Coqueiros , Aracaju ou São Cristóvão

O processo de seleção será feito de forma remota. A empresa avaliará os candidatos com base nos requisitos informados, e o contato será realizado por telefone ou e-mail. Não é exigida experiência anterior, o que torna a vaga uma excelente porta de entrada para o mercado de trabalho.

Mesmo sem experiência, você pode aumentar suas chances se:

Demonstrar boa comunicação verbal

Ter disciplina e organização para trabalhar em casa

Mostrar disposição para aprender e crescer dentro da empresa

Essa é uma ótima oportunidade para quem deseja iniciar uma carreira, principalmente com a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto . title: Shopify Web Developer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a skilled and proactive Shopify Web Developer & Site Maintenance Manager to support a luxury e-commerce brand in maintaining and optimizing their Shopify-based website. This role is ideal for a technically strong, detail-oriented individual who can manage ongoing site maintenance, identify and resolve issues efficiently, and contribute to the brand’s digital presence with consistent, high-quality improvements. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in Shopify development, experience with theme management and app integrations, and a problem-solving mindset. You’ll act as the go-to person for all web-related communication and be responsible for managing ongoing maintenance tasks, small enhancements, and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Manage Shopify theme backups and recommend new themes when necessary for major design overhauls
  • Conduct monthly app compatibility reviews to ensure performance and flag potential issues
  • Perform monthly site spot checks to identify broken links or functionality issues
  • Implement website improvements, including content updates, CTA adjustments, and UX enhancements
  • Handle ad hoc bug fixes and technical troubleshooting as needed
  • Oversee and manage the development task queue, acting as the main point of contact for web-related communication
  • Provide clear, structured monthly reports detailing tasks completed and hours used

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with Shopify development and website maintenance
  • Solid understanding of Shopify’s architecture, theme customization, and third-party app integrations
  • Experience managing content updates, site QA, and debugging
  • Strong organizational and project management skills; able to track multiple tasks and communicate clearly with stakeholders
  • Familiarity with performance optimization, UX improvements, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with e-commerce or luxury lifestyle brands
  • Knowledge of analytics and reporting tools to support performance-based decisions
  • Strong written communication skills for internal updates and reporting
  • Experience using tools like Trello, Asana, or similar for task and project tracking

About RYZ Labs

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and iconic consumer brands, with experience in Latam. The team works remotely and is distributed across the US and Latam, using cloud technologies to build scalable, resilient applications. RYZ aims to provide diverse product solutions and plans to build multiple startups in the coming years.

At RYZ, you will work with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide opportunities for learning, growth, expansion, and challenging projects, and you will collaborate with a team of professionals and specialists.

Our values

  • Customer First Mentality - every decision should be viewed through the customer lens
  • Bias for Action - urgency is critical, with accelerated timelines
  • Ownership - step up to help even if not your core responsibility
  • Humility and Respect - be willing to learn and treat everyone with respect
  • Frugality - being cost-conscious helps us do more with less
  • Deliver Impact - get things done efficiently
  • Raise our Standards - continuously improve processes, team, and expectations

Employment details

  • Seniority level: Not Applicable
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology
  • Industries: Technology, Information and Internet

Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá?

Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum!

Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Legal, né?

Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui.

E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP). Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores.

Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma cultura massa , a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo do Great Place to Work e em 2024 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos.

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração,comunicação, e claro, proximidade etransparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a dar match !

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

Dentro do time de Suporte sua missão será: Garantir que cada cliente tenha uma experiência eficiente, humana e resolutiva com o Astrea. Mais do que resolver dúvidas, o analista contribui para a construção de relações de confiança e para o sucesso dos escritórios que atendemos.

Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga: o modelo de trabalho é 100% Remoto!


Main responsibilities

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Realizar atendimentos consultivos aos clientes via chat e e-mail, garantindo clareza, empatia e resolutividade;
  • Prestar suporte sobre o uso do produto, orientando o cliente de forma didática e personalizada;
  • Registrar e encaminhar chamados técnicos, acompanhando a resolução junto aos times responsáveis;

  • Reunir e organizar dúvidas recorrentes dos clientes, contribuindo com insights para os projetos e melhorias em outras áreas;
  • Manter-se acima da média nas avaliações de atendimento, entregando uma experiência positiva em cada interação;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos de atendimento, com olhar crítico e foco em eficiência;
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do time, como reuniões de alinhamento e planejamento;
  • Contribuir na construção de ações de melhoria contínua, atuando de forma colaborativa no planejamento de processos

Requirements and skills

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Experiência prévia com suporte e/ou atendimento ao cliente por chat;
  • Domínio da língua portuguesa, além de bons conhecimentos em informática e digitação;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em período integral, de segunda a sexta, das 9h às 18h (40h semanais);
  • Ser comunicativo, ter empatia e facilidade para lidar com diferentes perfis de pessoas;
  • Ter senso de urgência e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma prática e eficiente;
  • Gostar de trabalhar em equipe, com colaboração e troca constante;
  • Ser comprometido com prazos e entregas, mantendo a qualidade no atendimento.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência prévia com a ferramenta Intercom;
  • Cursos ou vivência em gestão de tempo, gestão de projetos e gestão emocional;
  • Vivência com atendimento via e-mail ou chat, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de demandas;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de atendimento e boas práticas de Customer Experience (CX);
  • Ter atuado com suporte ao cliente em empresas de tecnologia, especialmente com produtos digitais ou SaaS.

Additional information

Com uma cultura de feedback , guildas de desenvolvimento , PDI no onboarding , Aurum Talks, reuniões frequentes com toda a Aurum, transparência em OKR, ações comemorativas, avaliação de desempenho, programas de desenvolvimento entre outros processos que ajudam a desenvolver cada vez mais as pessoas áureas.

Você é apaixonado por histórias? Adora escrever textos que inspiram, convencem e geram resultados? Tá sempre ligado nas tendências de marketing e não tem medo de colocar a mão na massa?
Então, essa vaga é pra você! ?
Na 4blue, nosso propósito é claro: transformar a vida de empresários e construir um mundo onde empreender vale a pena. Desde 2009, nos consagramos como referência em Gestão Empresarial para pequenas e médias empresas , ajudando empresários a tirar seus sonhos do papel e alcançar resultados reais .
Para esta grande missão, estamos sempre em busca de pessoas com muita energia, que têm a vontade de ir além e que sonham grande para somar com a gente em nossa missão.
Por que você vai se apaixonar pela 4blue?

  • Se você sonha grande, tem energia para transformar vidas e quer fazer parte de algo realmente relevante, você vai se sentir em casa aqui.
  • Nosso trabalho vai muito além de \"ensinar\": nós inspiramos e guiamos empreendedores rumo ao sucesso, ajudando-os a superar desafios sem precisar passar pelo medo de falir ou pelo estresse de não crescer.
  • Aqui jogamos para ganhar. Oferecemos cursos e consultorias, avaliamos e damos feedback. Sempre querendo melhorar, sempre jogando para ganhar.
  • Se a empresa ganha, você ganha. Nossa participação nos lucros pode te fazer tirar 1, 2, até 3 salários extras no ano!
  • Leveza com responsa. Somos leves e damos risada mesmo quando as coisas estão difíceis. Não gritamos, não brigamos, não humilhamos. Nossa gestão é humana e verdadeiramente nos importamos com as pessoas. Sim, somos leves, mas jogamos pra ganhar e vamos ganhar.
  • Home office: mais tempo no seu dia. O que dá pra fazer com 1 a 2 horas a mais no dia? Tem gente que acredita que trabalhar de casa não funciona, aqui provamos que dá sim pra trabalhar de casa com foco e com resultado, mas com muito mais qualidade de vida.
O que você vai fazer no dia a dia?
  • Impactar vidas com sua escrita: Criar textos persuasivos para e-mails, landing pages, anúncios, Whatsapp, redes sociais e muito mais, sempre com o propósito de inspirar e guiar empreendedores rumo ao sucesso.
  • Gerenciar ferramentas de marketing: Criar automações e gerenciar contatos em ferramentas como ActiveCampaign e Manychat.
  • Trazer novidades: Ficar de olho nas novidades do mercado e trazer ideias fresquinhas para nossas campanhas.
  • Dar apoio ao Time e Processos: Ajudar o time com insights, auxiliar no planejamento de campanhas, dar sugestões para melhoria do processo.
Requisitos Essenciais
  • Habilidades de copywriting e storytelling
  • Experiência comprovada com ferramentas de marketing (se for expert no Active Campaing, melhor ainda!).
  • Gramática e redação IMPECÁVEIS.
  • Ter autonomia e auto-responsabilidade para fazer acontecer e não temer mudanças.
  • Ser curioso, sedento por aprender e buscar novidades sempre (manja trends, hacks e até IA? Amamos isso!).
  • Ter um espaço silencioso em casa para trabalhar com foco total.
  • Ter um computador potente, capaz de lidar com as demandas de criação e ferramentas de marketing digital.
Requisitos desejáveis (serão um baita diferencial):
  • Domínio do Active Campaing.
  • Vivência com lançamentos digitais, iscas, inbound marketing e estratégias de venda no modelo perpétuo.
  • Conhecimento em testes A/B.
  • Experiência com home office.

description:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Engenharia de Dados AWS. Irá atuar na modalidade 100% remota.

Requisitos e qualificações;

  • Projetar e desenvolver pipelines de dados escaláveis utilizando serviços AWS, como S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda e EMR. Implementar soluções de ingestão, transformação e modelagem de dados com foco em alta performance e segurança;

  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados). Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis). Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

title: Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.


Media Buying & Strategy
  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.
Campaign Execution & Management
  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
Budget Management
  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.
Skills & Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote
