Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.
We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do
We’re looking for an Account Executive to accelerate Clara’s growth by generating and closing new business opportunities through 100% outbound efforts. You’ll play a key role in expanding Clara’s reach in Brazil by identifying, engaging, and converting high-potential prospects.

This is a self-driven sales role where you’ll manage your own pipeline end to end—from prospecting to closing—while representing Clara with clarity, discipline, and energy. Success will be measured by your ability to hit and exceed aggressive new client acquisition targets.

You will:

Own the outbound sales motion for your territory, from lead sourcing to signed contracts

Build and manage a high-volume pipeline through proactive prospecting and outreach

Set and consistently exceed monthly and quarterly sales goals

Track and optimize performance against KPIs such as outreach volume, conversion rate, and closed deals

Maintain detailed records of all sales activity and client interactions using Hubspot CRM

Act as a brand ambassador, clearly communicating Clara’s value proposition to potential clients

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

Strong pipeline management skills and a consistent record of exceeding outbound sales targets

Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities

Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

Working proficiency in Portuguese

Intermediate proficiency in English (reading, writing, and verbal communication)

Nice to haves

Experience in SaaS or the financial industry

Network within the financial ecosystem

Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn

Experience or interest in using AI tools to automate workflows

A good sense of humor

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

#Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

We’re seeking a finance-anchored analyst to partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance on revenue forecasting, CRM→ERP→GL reconciliation, and executive reporting . You’ll turn sales data into accurate forecasts and actionable insights aligned with best practices in revenue recognition.

Key Responsibilities

  • 1+ year in FP&A/revenue/sales finance,
  • ownership of revenue/pipeline models (ARR/MRR, cohorts, CAC/LTV).
  • 3+ years in FP&A, Sales Finance, Commercial Finance, or RevOps analytics (not pure accounting).
  • Advanced Excel (Power Query, pivots, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, what-if modeling) and one BI tool (Power BI/Tableau/Looker ).
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce/HubSpot and NetSuite/ERP .
  • Excellent English communication; able to translate data into clear business recommendations; thrives in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • SQL for ad-hoc analysis; SaaS/B2B metrics experience; exposure to revenue recognition concepts; sales compensation/commission modeling; experience with US-based teams; startup/scaling environment.

description:
Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Join to apply for the Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical .
We are building documentation capacity at scale. We have dozens of positions available , for products and teams across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff.
All applications and candidates are handled through this one entry-point. We'll be able to discuss seniority levels, suitable teams and more later in the process, to help place you in the most suitable role for you.
The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
The role entails

  • Create, maintain and improve software documentation
  • Work with engineering team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of the product, as an expert user of the product, who has important opinions about its function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team
What we are looking for in you
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation
  • Has a record of community engagement, in open-source software, documentation, research or other disciplines
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open-source software and its communities
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity, and is fascinated by software technology and its challenges
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight and enthusiasm
  • Has experience of software development contexts; is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, application deployment, system operations, and infrastructure management, Git, documentation markup languages
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events
Nice-to-have skills
  • Deep technical domain knowledge
  • Open-source community leadership and management
  • User-experience, interaction or visual design
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the \'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,\' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects , including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance .

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model .
  • Proven track record in data migration projects , including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar .
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing .
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE: Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

We’re looking for a skilled and conversion-driven Copywriter (Remote) to join the Marketing team at High Tide Inc., one of the largest cannabis and accessories companies in the world.   • Write compelling, on-brand email marketing copy for multiple D2C brands.

  • 3+ years of experience in copywriting for D2C or e-commerce brands.

  • Comfortable with A/B testing principles and performance-focused writing.

  • Responsive, collaborative, and able to handle quick turnarounds in a remote team.

Bonus Points For

  • Familiarity with Klaviyo and Figma (not mandatory).

  • Knowledge of the cannabis, wellness, or lifestyle industries.

  • Shape the voice of globally recognized cannabis and CBD brands through powerful copy.
  • Join a fast-paced, fully remote marketing team that values collaboration and creativity.

  • Write for brands that have a clear tone, engaged audiences, and room to grow.

How To Apply

This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

title: Community Associate
description:
Overview

Community Associate

BRASILIA, Corporate Financial Center

The world of work is changing…short commutes, flexibility, and convenience are the minimum standards employees want when it comes to how they want to work!

At IWG, we are leading the way. We’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work from wherever, and however they want…in over 120 countries across the globe!

Join us and help us bring more freedom to people and businesses, while expanding our network. You’ll be able to enjoy a great work life balance and competitive benefits, while growing your career path along the way.

The opportunity

As a Community Associate, you’ll work closely with new and existing customers across a myriad of industries, working to create and maintain your own community within your center, where you will help take care of all the administrative and support needs for your customers…so that your customers can focus on running their business.

A typical day at IWG

You arrive a few minutes before your center opens to make sure everything is ready and check there’s nothing the cleaners have missed.

Customers arrive all throughout the morning. One asks you for a changed WiFi code. Another wants to know if his important package has arrived. A woman needs directions to her meeting room… and can you help her set up the projector and show her where to find a great cup of coffee. You’re off to help her get set-up, as soon as you connect the incoming call to another customer. You may sure that all of the services are properly charged, so that invoices are accurate.

It’s time for a quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

The mail arrives. You sort through it while dealing with a whole host of other customer requests, remembering to email the customer from earlier to let him know his package is waiting for him in his mailbox. And that’s lunch.

A new wave of customers arrive throughout the afternoon. You help a customer with printing and another with their invoice. A customer in a team room say it’s too hot in their office, no problem you are on it and open a ticket in our service portal.

You’ve earned yourself another quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

Early afternoon, you sit down with the Community Manager to discuss the organization of next week’s networking event in your center. You plan and write the e-invites to customers, then create, print and put-up posters on the noticeboards around the center. To your excitement, the Community Manager is coming around the corner with a prospect (someone interested in joining the IWG community), you share a few details about what makes this space so amazing for your customers and encourage them to join the network soon so they can participate in next week’s networking event – then you head back to finish putting up your posters.

The day is coming to a close. Time to gently ask the large group in meeting room 3 to start wrapping up. You direct them to the nice restaurant you know around the corner, so they can grab a bite and continue their discussion. You ensure everything’s nice and tidy, it’s time to head home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who knows how to manage multiple tasks while providing customers with the best possible service. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, with the ability to build strong professional relationships and empathize with people’s needs (Ideally 1+ years of customer service experience)
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic, and able to adapt to fast-changing situations
  • Experience and confidence using MS Office and other basic IT equipment
  • Legally eligible to work in the Country you are applying within and at least 18 years old
  • B1 or higher level of English communication skills

What we offer

On top of a competitive total compensation package, you’ll enjoy:

  • Work life balance(no standard nights/weekends)
  • Generous paid time off plans (sick and vacation)
  • Paid Company Holidays per calendar year (in addition to your PTO accrual)
  • A quarterly bonus plan program, with a competitive salary rate
  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities aligned with great career path opportunities
  • A professional workplace community (business casual attire required)

A Day In The Life

As a Landing Page Strategist, you’ll play a critical role in executing and optimizing high-performing landing pages that drive real business results across lead generation, paid media, and eCommerce campaigns. You’ll work closely with senior strategists, paid media teams, lifecycle marketers, account managers, and creatives to support the day-to-day management of our clients’ landing page programs. This includes strategic planning, copywriting, QA, stakeholder communication, A/B testing, reporting, and ongoing optimization. This is a client-facing, detail-oriented role ideal for someone with a passion for conversion strategy, digital marketing, and performance design. You’ll gain deep hands-on experience across the entire landing page lifecycle while helping execute and grow one of our most impactful service lines.

Responsibilities

Client Execution & Project Management

  • Own the execution of landing page deliverables across strategy, copywriting, design feedback, development handoff, QA, and launch
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for internal teams and assist with client communication when needed
  • Translate paid media strategy and campaign briefs into high-converting landing page experiences
  • Work within structured workflows and project management tools (e.g., Asana) to track deliverables and meet timelines
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, and Development teams to align messaging, offers, and user experience

Landing Page Strategy & Optimization

  • Assist in developing and refining landing page strategies that align with funnel stages and campaign goals
  • Conduct CRO audits, scroll map/click map reviews, and post-launch performance analysis to surface insights and optimizations
  • Support A/B testing strategy creation, execution, and reporting
  • Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design
  • Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Conduct device and browser testing to validate performance and mobile usability

Collaboration & Growth Enablement

  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

Role Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred).
  • Portfolio of work examples with proven results
  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc
  • Experience working with design platforms like Figma
  • Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Implement AI-driven automation 50%+ of landing page workflows.
  • On-time delivery of landing page milestones (strategy, copy, QA, launch)
  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback
  • A/B testing velocity and learnings logged

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Execute Flawlessly Across the Landing Page Lifecycle – Deliver end-to-end execution across strategy, copy, QA, and launch
  • Drive Conversion-Focused Results – Apply best practices and insights to improve performance and meet client goals
  • Collaborate Across Teams – Serve as the operational glue between Paid, Lifecycle, Creative, and Dev teams

description:
Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - AMER

About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, excellent quality and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Senior Specialist is also expected to drive process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law considered a plus.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR advice and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues and apply problem-solving skills to independently (occasionally with minimal supervision) arrive at solutions, undertake research and translate this into usable team resources, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, while conveying authority and expertise as the representative of Remote, and maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying, developing and implementing opportunities for automation and champion best practice.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment while successfully balancing multiple competing priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and ability to inspire others.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits with minimal supervision across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide sound and trusted guidance with an elevated level of knowledge on key jurisdictions, and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, successfully navigating and directing multiple stakeholders with competing interests through a complicated, involved and sometimes lengthy process.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, among other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Act as the first point of informal escalation as a trusted colleague with good judgment, by way of providing expertise, mentoring and guidance to more junior team members.
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on Remote's Employee Relations resources, helping clients navigate complex workplace scenarios.
  • Conduct thorough preliminary assessments of workplace concerns, identifying key facts, applicable local regulations, and potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for internal and external stakeholders on employee relations matters, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Guide clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches, documentation requirements, and best practices for handling difficult situations.
  • Track and monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and appropriate coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and proactively resolve internal and external queries on all offboarding and first-level employee relations matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities, advocate for and drive process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.
  • Determine methods, procedures and standards on new assignments. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results taking into account wider Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: AMER
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Join to apply for the Salesforce CPQ Analyst (Remote) role at Percona

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce CPQ Specialist to join our team and take ownership of our Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) system within the Salesforce ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Salesforce CPQ solutions to improve sales efficiency, quoting accuracy, and revenue operations.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Finance, Product, and IT to translate complex business needs into scalable, robust Salesforce CPQ configurations.
What Will You Do:

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain Salesforce CPQ solutions to support business processes including quoting, pricing, approvals, and product configurations.
  • Analyze existing CPQ processes and recommend improvements to enhance automation and efficiency.
  • Build and manage CPQ product bundles, pricing rules, discount schedules, lookup tables, quote templates, and approval workflows.
  • Work with stakeholders to gather requirements, document solutions, and manage the end-to-end implementation lifecycle.
  • Ensure data integrity and system reliability by developing test plans and conducting regular audits.
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for all configurations and processes. Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting, and training to empower our end-users.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce developers and admins to integrate CPQ with other Salesforce clouds and third-party systems (e.g., ERP, billing, e-signature).
  • Stay current with Salesforce CPQ best practices, updates, and releases.
What Have You Done:
  • 3–6+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (SteelBrick).
  • Strong understanding of CPQ concepts such as product configuration, pricing models, discounting, and quoting.
  • Proven experience with Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud in particular), including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Flow, with basic knowledge of APEX and LWC preferred.
  • Ability to create complex CPQ rules: Price Rules, Product Rules, Summary Variables, Configuration Attributes, etc.
  • Experience with integrated CLM tools (e.g., DocuSign, Conga, Ironclad).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Salesforce CPQ Specialist Certification required.
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder and Advanced Admin Certification.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Familiarity with B2B SaaS pricing models.
  • Experience with multi-currency and multi-language Salesforce orgs.
Why Percona?
At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.
Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.
Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.
If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!
Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional

Estagiário de Design Gráfico - Criação de Mídias Digitais. Atenção: Esta é uma vaga de estágio.

Horário de trabalho: 10h às 17h

Salário: R$ 800 + vale alimentação de R$ 29 por dia. Totalizando uma média de R$ 1.380 de salário.

Informações adicionais: A posição é remota, de segunda a sexta-feira.

Requisitos

  • Estar cursando o 3º ano da faculdade de Comunicação e Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Bom conhecimento de português, habilidades de redação e interpretação de texto.
  • Conhecimento básico em marketing digital.
  • Entendimento de Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram.
  • Muita responsabilidade, organização e atenção aos detalhes; capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas simultaneamente.
  • Capacidade de se auto-gerenciar, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidos.
  • Conhecimento básico em edição de imagem e vídeo, com bom senso estético; familiaridade com Photoshop, Canva, Corel.
  • Boa comunicação para trabalho em equipe; familiaridade com sistemas de monitoramento de desempenho é valorizada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de layouts para posts em todas as plataformas digitais.
  • Editar vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok.
  • Criação de peças digitais com direcionamento do superior.
  • Desenvolvimento de conteúdo criativo para posts de Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok.
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas.
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas.

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte de nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação com o assunto: Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome. Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, inclua exemplos de artes que já tenha produzido e demonstre seu potencial para crescer como membro da equipe.

Envie sua candidatura para o Anúncio. A posição é remota, de segunda a sexta-feira.

Sobre Nós

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos experiência e excelência nos serviços que oferecemos. Valorizamos ética, responsabilidade e diversidade, e encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias.

Localizações Anunciadas

Monte Alegre do Sul, SP; Bom Jesus dos Perdões, SP; Bragança Paulista, SP.

title: Editor, Marketing
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Editor, Marketing role at Darkroom .

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
  • Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
  • Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
  • Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
  • Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
  • Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
  • Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on reach, engagement, and conversion.
  • Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
  • Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

Production Excellence

  • Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
  • Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
  • Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
  • Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
  • Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
  • Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

You’re a Great Fit If You:

  • Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
  • Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
  • Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
  • Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YT Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
  • Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
  • Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
  • Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

Bonus Points If You:

  • Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
  • Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
  • Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

What It’s Like To Work At Darkroom

We’re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays per year.
  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Equity incentives and a profit-sharing opportunity.
  • Opportunities for growth across disciplines through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Structural BIM Specialist SR (Civil Engineer)

Join to apply for the Structural BIM Specialist SR (Civil Engineer) role at ENG.

Overview

We are a leading BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused Building Information Modeling (BIM) services. Established in 2007, we have grown to become the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, with a portfolio of over 5,000 completed projects. Our dedicated team of more than 500 professionals offers a comprehensive range of services, including Structural & MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM. We work closely with architects, engineers, and owners to deliver tailored BIM solutions that meet their unique needs.

Role

As a Structural BIM Specialist (Civil Engineer) , you will create accurate and detailed BIM models for Structural and civil (ideally infrastructures or utilities). Your role involves reviewing project specifications and design information to ensure constructible, precise, and high-quality models. You will work both autonomously and as part of a team, identifying and resolving conflicts during the modeling process and ensuring the final product meets client expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Modeling and Design: Develop accurate structural and civil BIM models using Revit as the main tool, with Navisworks for coordination. Experience with Civil 3D is a strong plus.
  • Review and Analysis: Interpret and analyze project documents, such as structural drawings, specifications, and submittals, ensuring accuracy and constructibility.
  • Conflict Resolution: Identify and resolve potential clashes during modeling and coordination with other disciplines.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with other engineers, architects, and project managers to deliver integrated BIM solutions.
  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience in structural and civil modeling within BIM projects.
  • Software Skills: Proficiency in Revit is required. Experience with Navisworks and Civil 3D is desirable.
  • Education: Degree in Civil Engineering.
  • Language Skills: Proficient or advanced level of English (spoken and written).

You Are Great for This Role If You

  • Have strong attention to detail .
  • Demonstrate excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Enjoy problem-solving and working in a collaborative environment.
  • Are motivated to grow within a global BIM leader.

Company Culture and Values

  • Candor: We value honesty, openness, and sincerity in all interactions.
  • Accountability: We take ownership and are committed to delivering high-quality work on time.
  • Win-Win Mentality: We strive for mutual success in all business relationships.
  • Internal mobility across teams and projects
  • Performance-based promotions

Location

All positions at ENG are fully remote.

Compensation

Competitive compensation in USD, commensurate with experience.

The Open Wing Alliance (OWA), a program of The Humane League, is a global coalition of approximately 90 animal protection organizations across 70+ countries united in a common goal: to end the abuse of chickens worldwide. For the past several years, we have focused our efforts on eliminating battery cages by securing cage-free policies from major retailers, restaurants, and manufacturers. As the OWA Latin America Corporate Strategy Lead, you will serve as a key subject matter expert on corporate campaigning and corporate outreach for the OWA in Latin America. You’ll be responsible for building relationships with OWA member groups and providing advice, coaching, and training in order to develop campaign knowledge and skills across the animal protection movement in the region. We want you because you are an experienced campaigner and strategic thinker with excellent interpersonal skills. You are excited about collaborating with organizations across Latin America to maximize impact for animals, and you have a deep determination to remove the worst forms of animal suffering from companies’ supply chains. This position reports to the Sr. OWA Latin America Manager.
This is a full-time, remote position. This position requires domestic and international travel, equivalent to 6-10 trips per year, and requires a valid, up-to-date passport.   • Lead in-person and virtual trainings for OWA groups on corporate campaigning and corporate outreach.
  • Develop and implement personalized support plans and trainings for OWA groups.
  • Build strong relationships and trust with OWA groups, alongside a reputation as a sharp strategic thinker and strategist.

Strong portfolio showcasing system-level thinking and component design for complex digital products. Experience collaborating closely with engineers on component implementation, QA processes, and internal tooling development. Ability to facilitate cross-team design critiques, reviews, and workshops.
  • Leadership & Autonomy: Proactive problem-solver who can lead projects with minimal oversight. Track record of improving design processes and enabling broader teams to move faster and more efficiently. Comfortable operating across multiple workstreams and aligning cross-functional teams.

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

  • Strong pipeline management skills and a consistent record of exceeding outbound sales targets

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently
  • Based in Brasília

Nice to haves

  • Experience in SaaS or the financial industry
  • Network within the financial ecosystem
  • Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools to automate workflows
  • A good sense of humor

Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.
  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.
  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.
  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.
  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.
  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.
  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.
  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.
  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of.
  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.
  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one
  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)
  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths
  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together
  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact
  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

Overview

Quem é Stone Tech? A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Sênior Data Engineer

Estamos buscando pessoas engenheiras de dados com background e expertise na área, criativas, com energia, comprometidas, que saiba trabalhar bem em equipe, com foco de resolver o problema do cliente com muita qualidade e que queiram encarar conosco o desafio de fazer parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo Crédito da Stone.

Nosso produto está na rua a todo vapor e queremos escalar ainda mais nosso produto ampliando a sua capacidade, aproveitando todo seu potencial e melhorar ainda mais os pilares técnicos e de eficiência. Nosso produto tem interação com diversas fontes de dados importantes e cruciais para a vida do ciclo de crédito, sejam nossos dados internos cadastrais e transacionais, dados de provedores externos sobre endividamento, restritivo, rede de relacionamento, garantias e os diversos dados internos da companhia. Integrar, transformar e disponibilizar esses dados não é uma tarefa fácil e com todo volume que temos o desafio se torna ainda maior. Pra continuar no caminho certo, precisamos das melhores pessoas, que saibam contribuir bem em time e trabalhar sem ego, afinal, só como um time temos grandes resultados!

Importante lembrar que o nosso desafio requer pessoas com pensamentos de processar dados, construindo processos de qualidade e dispostas a construir sistemas altamente escaláveis e resilientes.

Junto Ao Time, Você Será Responsável Por

  • Você irá compor um time de alta performance com o foco em: projetar, desenvolver, testar, implantar, manter e melhorar o processos de engenharia de dados com foco em solucionar problemas reais dos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar na construção de soluções com visão de longo prazo e muita qualidade;
  • Você será um defensor das boas práticas, nossos acordos e processos, revisões, testes e documentações dentro do seu time e influenciar esta cultura o máximo possível;
  • É esperado de você extrema facilidade de trabalho em equipe, muita franqueza e transparência para que no dia-a-dia possa ter ótimo relacionamento com o time e transmitir conhecimento;
  • Aqui todos possuem a mente aberta para trabalhar com qualquer tecnologia, muita vontade de aprender e entregar resultado, além de ser apaixonado por tecnologia e sistemas de alta performance;

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência em linguagem de desenvolvimento para ferramentas e rotinas de Data Engineering (Python, Java, Scala ou outras);
  • Processo de Data Quality / qualidade e testes para Engenharia de Dados;
  • Conhecimentos sobre BigQuery / Datalake;
  • Conhecimentos de processamento com Databricks / ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Experiência com operação de serviços na nuvem;

O Que Aumenta As Suas Chances

  • Conhecimentos de negócio de Crédito e Risco;
  • Conhecimento de provedores de dados como SCR, Boa Vista (BVS), Serasa etc;
  • Experiência em projetos voltados para a área financeira;
  • Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias em geral é sempre um diferencial;

Nossos Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio Creche
  • PLR
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
  • E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Pour faire équipe avec nous et débuter une nouvelle aventure, postulez dès maintenant !

Job Title: KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER – UK & IRELAND

Location: UK & IRELAND


Ideal Candidate Location: South Central/Southeast UK due to key account concentration, but all UK candidates considered with willingness to travel

Join a Global Leader in the Construction sector!

Are you a strategic, results-driven Key Account Manager with a passion for building and growing relationships with distributors and stockists? Do you thrive on turning insights into profitable strategies and driving sustainable growth? If so, we’re partnering with a globally renowned manufacturer of innovative, design-led Construction solutions to find a dynamic professional to elevate their UK & Ireland distribution network.

About Our Client

About Our Client

Our client is a trailblazer in the design and manufacture of sustainable, high-quality Construction products for commercial and residential markets worldwide. With over 55 years of heritage, they lead with creativity, innovation, and a commitment to environmental responsibility. Join a vibrant, trendsetting team that delivers excellence and inspires through cutting-edge solutions.

The Opportunity

As Key Account Manager for the UK & Ireland, you’ll be at the forefront of driving growth with key distribution and retail partners. This strategic role offers high autonomy, blending proactive new business development (“hunting”) with nurturing existing accounts (“farming”). You’ll translate data-driven insights into actionable strategies, collaborating with senior management and internal teams to shape market success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and expand relationships with key accounts across the UK & Ireland.
  • Develop strategic account plans with clear objectives, risk assessments, and measurable outcomes.
  • Proactively identify new business opportunities while strengthening existing partnerships.
  • Leverage market analysis, customer needs, and competitor insights to drive growth.
  • Use tools like Excel (pivot tables), PowerPoint, and Outlook to craft compelling presentations and strategies.
  • Act as a trusted partner to clients, listening actively and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Operate independently from home or their London showroom, with UK-wide travel and occasional international trips (3-4+ times/year).

Your Profile

  • 3+ years in B2B sales or key account management with a focus on relationship-building within the distribution arena.
  • You’re a proactive, commercially savvy professional with a track record of success.
  • Sector experience is a bonus but not essential, what matters is your knowledge of the sales channels and your ability to deliver results and inspire trust.
  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable with data-driven decision-making and tools like Excel and PowerPoint.
  • A natural “hunter” and “farmer,” adept at winning new business and growing existing accounts.
  • Customer-centric with excellent listening and problem-solving skills.
  • Independent, entrepreneurial, and confident in high-level strategic decisions.
  • Fluent in English (additional languages a plus).

Why Join?

  • Impactful Role: Shape the future of a global leader’s UK & Ireland distribution network.
  • Autonomy & Flexibility: Manage your market with trust and independence
  • Career Growth: Thrive in a supportive, innovative environment with clear paths for career development.
  • Sustainable Impact : Be part of a company driving positive change through eco-conscious solutions.

Ready to Elevate Your Career?

Join a global leader and make a lasting impact in the world of sustainable Construction solutions. Apply now to take the next step in your career with a company that values innovation, excellence, and you! Take action and apply today!

SALARY & BENEFITS

HIGH BASIC SALARY (UP TO £67,000) + LOW TAX COMPANY CAR or STRONG CAR ALLOWANCE + EXCELLENT BONUS PACKAGE + OVER TARGET ACCELERATORS + PENSION + HEALTHCARE (INDIVIDUAL and FAMILY) MOBILE + LAPTOP + 25 DAYS HOLIDAY + CAREER DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES
